newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to reveal Oct trade balance next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to reveal Oct trade balance next week.

text.p: Brazil's Ministry of Industry and Commerce will not reveal the trade balance for October this week, a spokeswoman said.
The spokeswoman said the balance, expected to be a deficit which some analysts are putting as high as $1.0 billion, will be released next week but no day had yet been set.
Speculation over Brazil's ballooning trade deficit after a larger-than-expected $655 million gap in September has made markets nervous and caused wariness among international investors.
But government officials say 1996 will end with a current account deficit of less than 3.0 percent of gross domestic account, which they say should be easily financed.
